messages:
Sam: Pushing an urgent escalation — customer AstraNova's trial is blocked during onboarding. SSO embed token exchange returns 403, preventing activation. They also show a 35% drop in session starts since yesterday. Support labels as P1 and requests CS takeover. @Maya please advise. ticket #T-9821
Maya: On it. Can you paste the exact error and the last successful flow? Also need customer tier and renewal window.
Sam: Tier: Mid-market. Renewal ~40 days. Error snippet from logs:
```
POST /api/v1/embed/token 403 {"error":"forbidden","detail":"tenant_mismatch"}
```
They rotated keys and cleared cache — no change. This is blocking their onboarding steps.
Diego: I can triage tenant routing — looks like an identity mapping mismatch between the IdP config and our tenant id mapping service. I'll run a sanity check: `redis-cli --scan | grep astra` and check the mapping table. ETA ~25m.
Maya: Thanks — Diego, if it's tenant_id mapping we need a quick remediation path + a post-incident test. Olivia, please prepare a short proactive comms for the customer and an internal comm for Sales/Support. Key points: acknowledgement, ETA, mitigation (manual token/provisioning), contingency (temporary workspace).
Olivia: Drafting now. Proposed customer blurb:
"Hi <AstraNova team> — we’re sorry for the interruption. We’re actively investigating an issue with your SSO token exchange and expect a fix within 2 hours. As a temporary measure we can manually provision the workspace so you can continue onboarding. We will follow up with a 1:1 session to complete setup."
I'll also post an internal note in #customers-communications and ping Sales (Liam).
csbot: Ticket T-9821 created and assigned to cs-oncall. Severity: P1.
Sam: Diego reports tenant id mismatch confirmed; he pushed a hotfix to the mapping service and reissued the token. Customer confirms onboarding flow resumed and session starts recovering.
Sam: Recommend CS-led outreach and a 1:1 onboarding session, plus adding a tenant_id sync check to our onboarding eval suite.
Maya: Agreed. Olivia — please schedule a 1-hour handoff call today at 14:00 PT, include Sales and Solutions (Diego). Also raise a regression alert with eng to add a CI test for token exchange.
Olivia: Invite sent to AstraNova, Sales (Liam), Diego, and Sam. Included apology script and next steps in the calendar description. :white_check_mark:
Sam: Updating ticket with logs and closing the immediate loop. Thanks team :raised_hands:
Maya: Great work. Please add post-mortem notes in T-9821 and tag me when the incident write-up is ready.
